verdict.rationale: Bland's pathways support draft vs. published production versions, staging promotion, and A/B testing before rollout (bland-docs-2, bland-docs-19, bland-docs-21), plus enterprise-grade canary deployments and pinned release adoption so infra stays on a chosen version until you advance it (bland-docs-14, bland-docs-29, bland-docs-31). The testbed lets you isolate, edit, and re-run past call interactions for review (bland-docs-8, bland-docs-28, bland-docs-32), and dev/staging/production environments (bland-docs-42) plus evals (bland-docs-43) support review workflows. Missing for 10: explicit named 'rollback/revert' action or version history/diff UI, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
